page: Microsoft Azure HX176-96rs is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the HX instance family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor, paired with 1408.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 14.67 GB per core.

The server includes 4332 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is Premium Storage capable. It supports Remote Direct Memory Access (RDMA) networking, which enables low-latency, high-throughput inter-node communication. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this instance.

Given the high density of both memory and local NVMe storage, this server class is designed for resource-intensive enterprise workloads. The combination of dedicated compute cores, massive RAM capacity, and RDMA capabilities makes it suitable for large-scale databases, high-performance computing simulations, and memory-intensive data processing tasks where network latency and storage speed are critical bottlenecks.
